Phase-14.NAME: OneCommandInstall
Phase-14.purpose: Add a one-command GitHub installer for MAGRA.

steps.step-1: Create scripts/install.sh with dependency checks for git, npm, and Node 22.
steps.step-2: Clone or update https://github.com/anyagixx/MAGRA.git into the local MAGRA install directory.
steps.step-3: Support MAGRA_REF, MAGRA_INSTALL_DIR, MAGRA_BIN_DIR, MAGRA_REPO_URL, and --dry-run.
steps.step-4: Build MAGRA and create a local magra command shim without sudo.
steps.step-5: Document the curl-to-bash installer as the first README install path.
